commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  listado -e C0_ANVL_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds -t 160000 -
  listado -e C0_ANVL_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds_IPV -t 160000 -
else
  listado -e C0_ANVL_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds -t 160000 -
  listado -e C0_ANVL_BONDS | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_MultiSource_Bonds_IPV -t 160000 -
fi
